identity.symptom: reload stays failed after dotenv repair until cli restart

what: Development reloads remain rejected after repairing dotenv until the CLI restarts.
expected: Both ordinary and prepared sessions activate a repaired environment without restarting.
observed: Ordinary mode rebuilds using stale values; prepared mode does not enqueue dotenv repairs. Restarting with unchanged repaired files succeeds.
root_cause: CliDevSupervisor previously forwarded only startup/options environment into a --no-env-file candidate. Deleted values could return through inherited process.env in packages/supervisor/src/candidate-process.ts:55. The prepared epoch filter excluded all dotenv events in packages/cli/src/dev-snapshot/snapshot-epoch-path.ts:10. The fix resolves fresh values at dev-supervisor.service.ts:36.
fixed_by: Resolve each generation with bounded, joined Bun dotenv helpers and retained file-key ownership; explicitly unset removed inherited keys; preserve SDK/runtime overrides; observe every active standard dotenv file in both paths. Include Bun custom-mode fallback and mode-local precedence. Both complete real CLI/HTTP matrices pass without a process restart.

invariants: Latest valid generation activates without restarting the CLI
Rejected edits preserve previous-generation traffic and original diagnostics
File-managed removals cannot resurrect stale startup values
Unrelated inherited values and explicit runtime overrides survive
Resolved values stay in memory and snapshot validation stays single-use

environment.revision: ebc3a2544 plus local uncommitted recovery changes
environment.target: macOS, Bun 1.3.10; disposable installed minimal 0.7.6 app; source CLI; all processes stopped
environment.monitoring: Actual CLI generation/provider diagnostics, generated runtime HTTP logs, exact handler-body assertions and native descendant PID probes. No remote telemetry.

reproduction: Start a valid minimal app with bun dev.
Add a required RECOVERY_REQUIRED env contract and wait for candidate rejection.
Create .env.local with the missing synthetic value.
Assert another generation activates in the same CLI; this times out in both startup paths.
Restart without further source repair and assert startup succeeds.
For the after replay, copy templates/default/v1/minimal into a temporary app and bun install --network-concurrency 2.
Run packages/cli/tests/dev-environment/recovery.probe.ts with the temporary app and an evidence directory. It owns literal bun dev runs for ordinary and prepared startup.
The probe uses /recovery so the custom app uses complete graph readiness verification instead of the scaffold-only /hello greeting contract.

before.note: Ordinary repair assertion exits 1; candidate still lacks newly provided value.
Prepared repair assertion exits 1; no new candidate admitted.
Control restart succeeds using the same repaired files.
Two regression assertions fail against preserved HEAD supervisor/epoch implementations.
Custom NODE_ENV file-selection gap reproduced before correction.
Pinned Bun mode-local behavior reproduced before correction.

after.note: Both unchanged CLI PIDs recover throughout the entire expanded environment/source matrix; all observed descendants exit.
Ordinary native generations, original rejection diagnostics and joined shutdown.
Prepared activation, fallback recompilation, original rejection diagnostics and joined shutdown.
15 focused tests pass, including all standard modes, expansion, deletion, inherited values and overrides.
All local suite stages and final guardrails pass after additional fixture/manual watcher repairs.

before.assertion: Native candidates use fresh values and prepared epochs admit dotenv repairs

after.assertion: 15 focused tests pass; the previously failing resolver and epoch assertions now pass

runtime.reason: Development reload orchestration is a CLI workflow, with real generated HTTP responses used as semantic probes rather than an API for triggering reloads.
runtime.boundary: literal bun dev -> real filesystem watcher/compiler/graph -> supervisor candidate -> stable HTTP proxy -> generated handler
dependencies: Actual workspace CLI/compiler/supervisor/engine modules and installed minimal app 0.7.6
Native Bun dotenv helpers, filesystem/process/watch adapters and prebuilt inspector
Local service provisioning is off; the minimal fixture has no external provider
steps: Start one CLI per startup mode
Reject a missing required value while old traffic serves
Repair/create/change/atomically replace/delete dotenv files and assert exact HTTP values
Reject and repair source syntax, graph descriptors, imports, config and deleted files; save multiple files during compilation
Stop during compilation and assert listeners and all observed descendants disappear

before.assertion: Dotenv repair activates a new generation without restarting

after.assertion: Ordinary and prepared CLI processes activate all repaired values and newest valid code while preserving previous traffic

e2e.assertion: Both complete real CLI/HTTP matrices pass with five observed descendants exited per shutdown

limitations: Verified locally on macOS with Bun 1.3.10; five Linux-only native watch tests were skipped by their platform guards.

Every local full-suite stage now passes. Existing Docker/cloud/provider and platform-specific tests retain their declared opt-in skips; hosted CI was not run. The reproduced fixes do not establish the cause of every historical lockup.

notes: Changes are uncommitted; all launched processes have stopped. Runtime probes verify every observed descendant and listener release, including inspector ownership.
A separate reproduced HTTP context propagation defect was found by the exact body assertion and fixed under related report bf-a2da0ca60e9c828fc35b84bd.

Bun-native values and expansion are retained. Tests cover multiline/quoted/empty/escaped values, inherited references, base/mode/local/mode-local precedence, mode exclusions, custom NODE_ENV fallback, repeated invalid-to-valid cycles and project isolation.
The initial custom /hello probe was correctly rejected by the scaffold greeting readiness contract; the custom fixture was moved to /recovery without weakening readiness checks.

A mixed Bun/Vitest runner invocation failed at test setup; the correct runners were used for all final passing checks. The watcher cleanup expectation was updated to record actual active test-mode filenames.

The original before fixture lived in the planning temporary directory, now gone. Its probe and assertion-bearing logs are retained under evidence/001; the probe selects the app path relative to its own file, independent of caller cwd.
